name: distill-clef-02
labels: model labels from Cloudflare Clef (omp judge role), NOT human labels; train-only silver candidates, provenance.annotator must be 'clef'
file: labels-all.jsonl: every labelled note, no filtering; thresholds NOT applied (the integrator picks them)

shards.s01..s20: 1,757-note pool of distill-clef-01 (queue.jsonl), relabelled with the rule-aware prompt
shards.rules: 638 hand-written R1-R4 notes (generated/distill-clef-02/rules-1..7.jsonl, 796 written; gate + human-value dedupe -> gated.jsonl 638 after dropping 3 exact dups of pool notes)

rules_gate: scripts/check_note_similarity.py (leakage rules vs eval/train refs, batch duplicates) + exact/NFC-lowercase match against human-value-01/02 (350 notes loaded in code, never printed); 1 note matched and was dropped

prompt.call: questions(text, rules=True) + ShotPool(training-v5 train + validation).state(text), 16 shots

known_weakness: on the rules shard the teacher follows R1, R3 (people), R4 (salary) but often labels R2 'tra ho/ung gium/mua ho/dong ho X ...' as expense (mostly < 0.6) and 'ung luong/tam ung' in longer notes as income/expense/repayment_out; check before training on those
